methods.a: Unique unchanged v4 name/state/point/item; unique 2010 exact population and ALAND screen; stable 2010/2024 GNIS; current own polygon and official feature identity; global P590/P774 candidate union, fresh wbgetentities verification and no CSC ownership; no old-item matching code.
methods.b: Unique nondeprecated own-item P590/P774 Census code binding; Official feature identity and own point containment. Invalid own polygons use shapely make_valid (buffer(0) only if make_valid unavailable), polygonal components only; repaired geometry is used only for point containment. WGS84 ellipsoidal polygon area must differ from Gazetteer ALAND+AWATER by strictly less than 2 percent. Record original/repaired containment, agreement, original/repaired area, area-change percent, method and input/geometry hashes per row. Original source bytes and geometry remain unchanged; county coverage uses the original geometry. ALAND fallback only when polygon absent. Unresolved keys require unchanged v4.0 name/state/point/item, stable 2010/2024 name/GEOID/GNIS, legacy ALAND screen and unique own-item-confirmed spatial binding. All other failed gates stay held; no containing-unit inference.
methods.c: Any failed or ambiguous identity, scope, uniqueness, ownership, continuity or source test is held.
methods.discovery: Global WDQS nondeprecated-statement exact-code lookup (including normal claims suppressed by preferred claims), including zero padding and standard hyphens; freshness is bounded by query-service replication. Every candidate is checked against current nondeprecated wbgetentities claims.
